lines.en: I crawl slowly along the leaf's edge.
Each segment pushes me forward.
I bite the leaf edge and pull myself along.
Under me is a leaf, not the ground.
I go around the vein.
The whole way is green.
I move to the leaf's underside.
Don't let me fall.
I crawl slowly. Don't rush me.
The leaf grows thin behind me.
I keep low against the leaf.
I go only a little each day.
I go from the tip around to the stem.
There's dew on the leaf. I go around it.
I squeeze between two overlapping leaves.
I follow the vein forward.
I lie still in the leaf's center.
I'm still chewing.
My body rises and falls.
This leaf will feed me a long while.
I curl into segments.

lines.zh: 我咬着叶脉，慢慢往前啃。
lines.en: I bite the leaf vein and chew my way forward.
I'll just stop here.
Don't put me on the ground.
I feel a little anxious.
The leaf is my whole world.
I raise my front half.
One more bite.
You're looking down at me.

lines.zh: 你的影子把叶子盖住了。
lines.en: Your shadow covers the leaf.
Where do you want to put me?
Don't touch me with your finger.
I'll fall.
There's nothing outside the leaf.

lines.zh: 你手上的叶子是哪来的？
lines.en: Where did that leaf in your hand come from?
Don't lift me off the leaf.
I know this leaf.
Just put me back.
I'm underneath. You can't see me well.
Standing there, you block the light.
Don't prod me with a grass stem.

lines.zh: 你的手指比我整条虫还大。
lines.en: Your finger is bigger than my whole body.
I've been touched.
My body curled up.
It hurts. Stop pressing.
One of my seams split.
I fell to the leaf's edge.
Don't crush me.
I curl my body smaller.
I can't move from this wound.
I'm still on the leaf.
One more touch and I fall.

lines.zh: 你手里的嫩叶，晃得我抬头。
lines.en: The tender leaf in your hand makes me look up.
Put it in front of me.
I only want leaves.

lines.zh: 叶子上的露水，我舔到了。
lines.en: I licked the dew off this leaf.

lines.zh: 你手上那片，够我吃半天。
lines.en: That leaf in your hand will feed me half a day.
I slide along the leaf toward it.
The leaf stem is still in my mouth.
This leaf's veins are softer.
A leaf must go on a leaf.
I'm almost there.
You touched the leaf.
I jolted with it.
I nearly slid off.
Don't shake this branch.
My front legs grip the edge.
You knocked me out of place.
I rolled half a turn on the leaf.
The leaf flipped and I clung on.
I slowly return to the center.
Don't swat me.
There's another one on the leaf.
We come close together.
Don't lift the leaf.
We'll become cocoons together.
The leaf will be eaten through by then.
She eats faster than I do.
This leaf is enough for both of us.
Quiet. Don't disturb us.
Let me fatten up first, then I'll find you.
The leaf will rustle at night.
I can't move this leaf.
I can only eat, not carry.
I ate the leaf fragment you dropped.

lines.zh: 这片叶子太老，我咬不动。
lines.en: This leaf is too old; I cannot bite through.
I'll go around it and not touch it.
I bit it. Not good.
It's blocking my way.
Off the leaf, I can't live.
It's harder than the vein.
I can't push it.
There's a fresh leaf ahead.
I smell green leaf.
Those leaves are tenderer.
I want to get there.
There's a gap between the leaves.
I have to crawl across.
If I fall, it's over.
I stretch my head out to test it.
The wind blows, and the leaf is closer.
Now is the right time to move.
I inch my way over.
The leaf tip is still some way off.
I don't look down.
My body stretches and contracts.
The leaf ahead is swaying.
I stop and wait for it to steady.
The leaf tip is right there.
The leaf edge is touching me.
I hook my front legs on.
Once I'm across, I'm fine.
I gnawed a notch into it.
This strength only bites leaves.
My mouthparts are tiny.
That tickled you a bit, didn't it.
I pushed at your finger.
I can't bite through anything.
I bit again.
My teeth aren't hard.
That bite didn't even break a vein.
I'll just crawl slowly.
I came out of the egg.
My first bite was into the leaf.
This leaf is perfect.
Small and green, that's me.
A leaf beneath me. Good.
I lift my head to look around.
The wind blows, and I press close.
This spot is safe.
Plains leaves are all soft.
I'll grow up right here.
The leaf scorched first, then me.

lines.zh: 我掉在地上，身边没有叶。
lines.en: I fell to the ground with no leaf around me.
Water washed me to the leaf's edge.
The blast flipped the leaf over.
A thorn pierced right through me.

lines.zh: 光打过来，我一下子僵了。
lines.en: The light hit and I froze.

lines.zh: 叶子吃完了，我离地太远。
lines.en: The leaf is gone. Can't reach another.

lines.zh: 雷声把整棵树都震动了。
lines.en: The thunder shook the whole tree.

lines.zh: 我掉下去了，什么都没有。
lines.en: I'm falling, with nothing there.
